names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 29 octombrie, «Sfântul Cuvios Avramie și Maria, nepoata sa».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 29 Οκτωβρίου, «Όσιος Αβράμιος και Μαρία η ανεψιά του», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the title on his name link behind the line for 29 октября ст. ст., «Аврамий Затворник, Хиданский, пресвитер, прп.», with the rank word and the grade left off. «Затворник», the recluse, is kept because it is the by-name the calendar uses for him throughout and not a rank in the list this corpus reads ranks from; the village of Hidana is the second by-name. The line itself declines the name and gives neither.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 29. октобар ст. ст., „Преп. Аврамије Затворник и синовица му Марија.“ — «Преп.» is the `venerable` grade this corpus keeps in `types` and comes off, and «и синовица му Марија» is the second person the heading enumerates and no part of his name. «Затворник», the recluse, is KEPT: it is not in the brief’s rank table at all, this folder’s own Russian form keeps it («Аврамий Затворник, Хиданский»), and section 6 asks for the fullest form the calendar gives. `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM` for the stored form and for the bare «Аврамије» alike, so nothing here depends on the by-name.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 29 октября ст. ст. — «Прп. Аврамия затворника и блж. Марии , племянницы его (ок. 360).»
source.note: The line is the second of the day and carries no typikon icon, so no rank is recorded. The one life page behind it serves him and his niece together, and his life page lists this day and no other.

attestations.note: The Russian agrees with the Romanian and Greek days this folder was written from and adds the year it had not, the village, the attribution of the life, two hymns and the name of his see of mission. The name link titles him «Аврамий Затворник, Хиданский, пресвитер, прп.» — of Hidana, the village near Edessa the life names — which the folder's `types` already carry as `presbyter` and `hermit`.

source.text: doxologia.ro, 29 octombrie — «Sfântul Cuvios Avramie și Maria, nepoata sa»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 29ης Οκτωβρίου — «Όσιος Αβράμιος και Μαρία η ανεψιά του»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 29 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and the man is the folder's own: the ascetic who gave away a great inheritance, lived in a desert place, preached in the cities, and drew his brother's daughter Mary out of her sin. The same day's listing keeps a different Abramius, the archimandrite of Rostov, who is a new folder of this batch and not this man. saint.gr gives no year, so the folder's dateless state is unchanged. The proper apolytikion and the kontakion both name him and are taken; the «Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον» is the common «Ἐν σοὶ Πάτερ ἀκριβῶς» and is not drafted, and neither is the Οἶκος. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 11.11.2025 (29. октобар ст. ст.) — „Преп. Аврамије Затворник и синовица му Марија.“

attestations.note: The day’s second entry, which ENUMERATES TWO PEOPLE in one heading — «Преп. Аврамије Затворник и синовица му Марија» — so it is two folders and two rows, this one and `mary-niece-of-abraham`. Both already existed and already related one another in both directions, so no `related` row is owed either way. Quoted whole with the closing full stop; the same heading stands on both rows, which is what the brief’s enumeration ruling produces. `types` UNTOUCHED: «Преп.» is the `venerable` this folder holds and «Затворник», the recluse, the `hermit` beside it; the body’s «по заповести дотичног епископа» is an order he received and not a rank he held, and `presbyter` was already there from another book. `dates` UNTOUCHED AND A BIRTH DELIBERATELY NOT INFERRED. The folder holds `death` 360, displayed «about 360» off the Russian calendar’s «(ок. 360)», and NO birth. This entry says «Упокојио се мирно 360. год. у 70. години живота на земљи» — the same year, FLAT where the Russian hedges it, AND an age: in the seventieth year of his life. SUBTRACTING THE AGE FROM THE YEAR WOULD GIVE A BIRTH OF ABOUT 291 AND IT WAS REFUSED. The arithmetic is not in the book, the age is "in his seventieth year" rather than "aged seventy", and a `birth` is one of the nine things a machine may not decide. The display was also left as «about 360» rather than hardened to «360» on the strength of one flat statement, because the interval is already a point and only the hedge in the wording would change. WHAT THE BOOK ADDS, AND IT IS THE WHOLE SHAPE OF FIFTY YEARS. HE WAS FORCED BY HIS PARENTS TO MARRY AND ON THE VERY DAY OF THE WEDDING LEFT BRIDE, PARENTS, HOUSE AND EVERYTHING and withdrew into solitude for a great ascetic struggle. HE STRUGGLED FIFTY YEARS AND WENT OUT OF HIS CELL ONLY TWICE IN THE WHOLE OF THAT TIME: the first time at the command of his bishop, TO BRING A HEATHEN VILLAGE TO THE FAITH OF CHRIST; the second time TO SAVE HIS STRAYED NIECE MARY. That pair of exceptions is the entry’s whole architecture, and it is why the niece is in the heading at all. The bishop who gave the order is unnamed; the village is unnamed. No `locations`, no `office`. THE FORM IS FREE AND KEEPS ITS BY-NAME: `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM` for «Аврамије Затворник» AND for the bare «Аврамије», so the by-name was not needed to break a fold and is kept because section 6 asks for the fullest form the calendar gives — and because this folder’s own Russian form keeps the same word, «Аврамий Затворник, Хиданский». The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the day’s verse is Bishop Nikolai’s own and is about Abraham.

hymns.text: Întru tine, părinte, cu osârdie s-a mântuit cel după chip; că, luând crucea, ai urmat lui Hristos; şi lucrând, ai învăţat să nu se uite la trup, căci este trecător; ci, să poarte grijă de suflet, de lucrul cel nemuritor. Pentru aceasta şi cu îngerii împreună se bucură, Preacuvioase Părinte Avramie, duhul tău.

source.text: doxologia.ro, Troparul Sfântului Cuvios Avramie, Glasul 8

english.text: In you, father, the image was saved with all diligence; for taking up the cross you followed Christ, and by your works you taught us to overlook the flesh, since it passes away, and to care for the soul, a thing immortal. Therefore your spirit rejoices together with the angels, most venerable father Abraham.

hymns.text: Ζωῆς τῆς φθειρομένης λιπῶν τᾶς ἀπολαύσεις, ἐν τὴ τῶν μελλόντων ἐλπίδι, Ἀβράμιε θεοφόρε, ὁσίως ἐβίωσας ἐν γῇ, καὶ χρῖσμα ὑπεδέξω ἱερὸν διὰ τοῦτο ὡς τοῦ Λόγου μυσταγωγός, κατηύγασας τοὺς βοώντας, δόξα τῷ δεδωκότι σοι ἰσχύν, δόξα τῷ σὲ στεφανώσαντι, δόξα τῷ ἐνεργούντι διὰ σοῦ, πάσιν ἰάματα.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος α’, Τοῦ λίθου σφραγισθέντος — the first hymn on the page of «Όσιος Αβράμιος και Μαρία η ανεψιά του». It names him and no other saint. The reading «τᾶς» is the page's own and is copied as it stands.

english.text: Leaving behind the enjoyments of this perishing life, in the hope of the things to come, God-bearing Abramius, you lived on earth in holiness and received a sacred anointing; and so, as an initiate of the Word, you lit up those who cry: glory to him who gave you strength, glory to him who crowned you, glory to him who works healings for all through you.

hymns.text: Ἐν σαρκὶ ὡς Ἄγγελος, ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἀνεφάνης, καὶ ἀσκήσας γέγονας, πεφυτευμένον ὡς ξύλον, ὕδατι τῆς ἐγκρατείας καλῶς αὐξήσας, ῥεύματι τῶν σῶν δακρύων ῥύπον ἐκπλύνας· διὰ τοῦτο ἀνεδείχθης, δοχεῖον θείου, Ἀβράμιε Πνεύματος.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος γ’, Ἡ Παρθένος σήμερον — on the page of «Όσιος Αβράμιος και Μαρία η ανεψιά του». It names him and no other saint.

english.text: In the flesh you appeared on earth as an angel, and by your ascetic labour you became like a tree planted, well grown by the water of self-restraint, washing away defilement in the stream of your tears; and so you were shown to be a vessel of the divine Spirit, Abramius.

hymns.text: В тебе, отче, известно спасеся еже по образу:/ приим бо крест, последовал еси Христу/ и дея учил еси презирати убо плоть, преходит бо,/ прилежати же о души, вещи безсмертней.// Темже и со Ангелы срадуется, преподобне Авраамие, дух твой.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 29 октября ст. ст. — «Тропарь преподобнаго Авраамия затворника»
source.note: The common of a venerable father, with his name set into its last line, printed under his own heading, which makes it his (BRIEF.md §4).

english.text: In you, father, what is according to the image was surely saved; for taking up the cross you followed Christ, and by your deeds you taught us to despise the flesh, which passes away, and to care for the soul, a thing immortal. Therefore your spirit rejoices with the angels, venerable Abraham.

hymns.text: Во плоти яко Ангел на земли явился еси,/ и пощением был еси яко древо насажденное,/ водою воздержания добре возрастився,/ и теченьми твоих слез скверну омыв:/ сего ради явился еси// приятелище Божественное, Авраамие, Духа.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 29 октября ст. ст. — «Кондак преподобнаго Авраамия затворника»

english.text: In the flesh you appeared on earth as an angel, and by fasting you became like a planted tree, grown well by the water of abstinence and washed clean of defilement by the streams of your tears. Therefore you were shown to be a divine dwelling of the Spirit, Abraham.

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 29 октября ст. ст. gives the pair «(ок. 360)», and its life closes on him «После пятидесятилетней подвижнической жизни он мирно отошел ко Господу († около 360 года)» — fifty years of ascetic life and a peaceful death about 360. Neither the Romanian nor the Greek page this folder was written from gave any year.
